name: PROBLEM 6
author: swtdr34mz
summary: Formerly PROPHETIC 6. A port of the PROBLEM 6 firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: a 7-voice analogue-style poly with two oscillators (sub, noise, sync, poly mod), a high-pass into a resonant 4-pole low-pass, two LFOs, distortion, chorus, delay, five reverbs, an arp on the MPC tempo and a low split. HIGH and ECO quality. Panel-style touch pages.
